parameters.help_en:
The number of distinct roles used to differentiate speakers in the post-meeting Classification Result. This parameter takes effect only when AudioOutputEnabled=true, MeetingResultEnabled=true, and DocResultEnabled=true. The default value is 1.  
0: Differentiate roles for multiple speakers.  
1: Treat all speech as from a single speaker (no role differentiation).  
2: Differentiate roles for two speakers
parameters.help_zh:
会后进行识别结果角色区分人数，在AudioOutputEnabled=true、MeetingResultEnabled=true且DocResultEnabled=true 时生效，默认是1。
0：按多人进行角色区分。
1：按1人进行角色区分，即不区分。
2：按2人进行角色区分
parameters.name: meeting_role_num

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the docResult field in the post-meeting result stores only the role-to-UNIX timestamp mapping information, without transcription text. The default value is false
parameters.help_zh: 会后结果中docResult字段是否只存储角色时间戳映射信息，即不带转写文字结果，默认是false
parameters.name: only_role_split_result

MeetingStatus.description_en:
Meeting status.  
NEW: New meeting.  
ONGOING: Meeting transcription in progress.  
PAUSED: Meeting transcription paused.  
PRE_COMPLETE: Post-meeting intelligent extraction in progress after transcription ends.  
COMPLETED: Meeting completed.  
FAILED: Post-meeting intelligent extraction failed after transcription ends.  
INVALID: Invalid meeting
MeetingStatus.description_zh:
会议状态。
NEW：新会议。
ONGOING：会议转写中。
PAUSED：会议转写暂停。
PRE_COMPLETE：会议转写结束后，进行会后智能提取。
COMPLETED：会议完成。
FAILED：会议转写结束后，会后智能提取失败。
INVALID：无效会议
